test_download_function: test the iopath download function by downloading a URL to a file and verifying it exists
run_test_with_mocked_logger: run the TestDownload test suite with the EventLogger patched to suppress logging events
download_url_to_file: download a URL to a specified directory with a custom filename and no progress bar
cleanup_downloaded_file: remove a downloaded file in tearDown if it still exists on disk
generate_unique_test_filename: generate a unique test filename using uuid to avoid collisions across test runs
